text:
linda.ops: heads-up: canary in eu-north failed post-upgrade job. Deploy-bot paused promotion: `deploy-bot: promotion blocked - postupgrade job failed (hook: create-rbac)`

omar.eng: grabbing logs now. seeing `Error from server (AlreadyExists): clusterrolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io "auth-clusterbinding" already exists` when hook tries to create binding.

linda.ops: exact hook output: `Creating ClusterRoleBinding auth-clusterbinding
Error: clusterrolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io "auth-clusterbinding" already exists`

ira-sre: That looks like chart v3.1.0 removed the release-scoped suffix on clusterrolebinding name. We have multiple overlays targeting same cluster, so name collisions occur.

kyle-eng: Oof. We missed this in chart review. Options: 1) pin chart to v3.0.8 and re-run promotion (fast), 2) apply per-release values override to set `rbac.clusterRoleBindingName: auth-clusterbinding-{{ .Release.Namespace }}` (no chart publish), 3) hotfix chart and publish v3.1.1 (~45min).

sophie-pm: EU change window ends in 50m. If pinning is <15m we can finish. Overrides also quick but we need to coordinate per-release. Which is safest?

omar.eng: Per-release override is safest and fastest. Avoids touching DB or rolling back. I can craft the override and apply to the blocked groups.

linda.ops: go for override then. I'll set the deploy-bot per-release override for groups: eu-north, eu-west, eu-central.

omar.eng: override snippet to use with deploy-bot:
```yaml
rbac:
  clusterRoleBindingName: auth-clusterbinding-{{ .Release.Namespace }}
```
This will render the release namespace into the name at templating time.

deploy-bot: applying per-release values override -> service/auth@2026-04-02-321

deploy-bot: promotion paused -> override applied -> re-queueing blocked groups (eu-north, eu-west, eu-central)

kyle-eng: canary re-ran in eu-north, postupgrade hook now created binding with namespace suffix and succeeded. :white_check_mark:

sophie-pm: Release notes blurb: "Applied temporary per-release values override to avoid ClusterRoleBinding name collisions introduced by auth chart v3.1.0. A follow-up chart patch v3.1.1 will restore release-scoped names and include CI preflight checks."

ira-sre: Follow-ups: 1) PR to chart repo to reintroduce release-scoped names (v3.1.1), 2) add CI contract test for static global resource names, 3) update chart changelog template to call out name-breaking changes.

omar.eng: I'll open the PR and include tests. Also adding a lint that flags cluster/global resource names without release or namespace tokens.

linda.ops: I'll keep the overrides attached to the release grouping until v3.1.1 is promoted. Booked a follow-up canary tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: promotion complete -> all blocked groups promoted successfully (eu-north, eu-west, eu-central)

linda.ops: closing thread. Follow-ups filed in the auth chart epic. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
